description: This C# source file defines the internal sealed class 'NatsConnectionManager' which acts as a wrapper around NATS and JetStream APIs for managing connections, streams, message enqueuing, and consumers within Orleans Streaming infrastructure, specifically tailored for NATS JetStream server interactions.

classes.name: NatsConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages NATS and JetStream connections, streams, and message flow for Orleans streaming provider, including initialization, message enqueueing, and consumer creation.

methods.name: NatsConnectionManager
methods.description: Constructor to initialize connection manager with provider name, logger factory, and options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Establishes connection to NATS server and sets up JetStream stream; checks server capabilities.

methods.name: EnqueueMessage
methods.description: Enqueues a message into the NATS JetStream stream on the appropriate subject.

methods.name: CreateConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new NatsStreamConsumer for a specified partition.

methods.name: AcknowledgeMessages
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment to a subject, indicating message processing completion.
